_readme: Each block below is one pranayama. Durations are in seconds.
To use your teammate's curve file instead of the built-in shape, add: "curve_file": "curves/box.csv"
Optional with a curve file: "curve_fs": 10 (samples/second, ONLY for one-column files), "cycles_in_file": 3 (if the file holds 3 breath cycles).
With a curve file you may delete inhale/hold_in/exhale/hold_out - they are measured from the curve automatically.
Keys starting with an underscore (like this one) are ignored.

bhastrika.name: Bhastrika (Bellows Breath)
bhastrika.cue: Keep inhalation and exhalation equal and rhythmic.

kapalabhati.name: Kapalabhati (Skull-Shining Breath)
kapalabhati.cue: Let the inhale be passive and the exhale short and sharp.

nadi_shodhana.name: Nadi Shodhana (Alternate Nostril Breathing)
nadi_shodhana.cue: Block your right nostril to inhale through the left, switch to block the left nostril and exhale through the right, then repeat starting from the right side.

anuloma_viloma.name: Anuloma Viloma (Alternate Nostril Flow)
anuloma_viloma.cue: Let the exhalation be twice as long as inhalation.

bhramari.name: Bhramari (Humming Bee Breath)
bhramari.cue: Keep the humming sound steady throughout the exhalation.

ujjayi.name: Ujjayi (Ocean Breath)
ujjayi.cue: Keep the soft ocean-like sound smooth and even.

sama_vritti.name: Sama Vritti (Box Breathing)
sama_vritti.cue: Keep all four parts of the breath exactly equal.

sheetali.name: Sheetali (Cooling Breath)
sheetali.cue: Inhale slowly and smoothly, then exhale gently through the nose.

sheetkari.name: Sheetkari (Hissing Breath)
sheetkari.cue: Press your teeth together with lips parted, draw the air in smoothly through the crevices of your teeth with a hiss, and exhale slowly through both nostrils.

surya_bhedana.name: Surya Bhedana (Right Nostril Breath)
surya_bhedana.cue: Keep the breath slow and comfortable.
